core_obligations: Reduce to the quasi-compact case, the general case being analogous (proof lines 2278 and 2282-2283).

Use the free basis of $Z_k(X)$ by integral closed subschemes of $\delta$-dimension $k$ and describe the image of a basis element under the composition: it is $[Z \cap U]$ when $Z$ meets $U$, and zero when $Z \subset Y$ (proof lines 2278-2281).
Read off surjectivity on the right and exactness in the middle from that basis description (proof line 2281-2282).
proof_roadmap: Action of the maps on the free basis (proof lines 2278-2281).
Exactness from the basis description (proof lines 2281-2282).
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives right exactness of the sequence of cycle groups attached to an open subscheme, its reduced complement and the ambient scheme (statement lines 2262-2275). The proof treats the quasi-compact case through the free basis of integral closed subschemes, where the composition of the two maps either sends a basis element to the intersection with the open piece or to zero, and declares the general case analogous. The basis analysis is the substance, so the claim is H2.
